name: Volunteer State Community College
academic_ranking: 2-year public community college (Tennessee Board of Regents system). Student population 6,963 (all undergraduate), student-to-faculty ratio 19:1. Awards less-than-one-year and one-to-two-year certificates and associate's degrees. Suburban campus, no on-campus housing. Source: NCES College Navigator, unitid 222053.
financial_aid: In-state tuition & fees $4,756/yr; out-of-state $17,740/yr (NCES 2024-2025). Average net price for full-time beginning students $8,651 (2023-24). Participates in a state Promise program (Tennessee Promise) and offers a tuition payment plan. FAFSA-based federal, state, and institutional aid available; net price calculator at volstate.edu/FinancialAid. Source: NCES College Navigator 2024-25.
facilities_notes: Pioneers softball plays in the TCCAA / NJCAA Region VII (Gallatin, TN). Specific softball facility details were not published on the athletics site as of research date; no dedicated facilities page found.
program_reputation: NJCAA Division program competing in the Tennessee Community College Athletic Association (TCCAA) / NJCAA Region VII. Head coach Christian Lynn leads the program. Athletics site: volstatepioneers.com (PrestoSports).
notes: Researched 2026-07-30 via live fetch of volstatepioneers.com (PrestoSports). Softball staff directory (https://www.volstatepioneers.com/sports/sball/coaches/index) lists only one staff member: Head Coach Christian Lynn; no assistant coaches, recruiting coordinators, or graduate/volunteer assistants were publicly listed at research time. 2025-26 roster page listed 20 players. Conference confirmed as TCCAA / NJCAA on the softball index page. Tuition/academic/financial-aid figures sourced from NCES College Navigator (unitid 222053). NOTE: the given athletics domain occasionally served cached content from another school (Walters State / wsccathletics.com) during an early fetch; all data used here was verified against pages whose canonical URL is volstatepioneers.com.
